```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes"))) |>
  add_position_group(collect(select(tbl(con, "roster"), playerId, season, position))) |>
  filter(group != "Position not recorded")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
round_mix <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_drafted_d) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(drafted_seasons = n(), round1 = sum(outcome_draft_round_d == 1L), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(round1_share = round1 / drafted_seasons) |>
  arrange(desc(round1_share)) |>
  mutate(group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)))

p <- ggplot(round_mix, aes(100 * round1_share, group_f)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = group == "Quarterback",
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %d of %d drafted seasons in round 1 (%.1f%%)",
        group, round1, drafted_seasons, 100 * round1_share
      ),
      data_id = group
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%d of %d)", 100 * round1_share, round1, drafted_seasons)),
    hjust = -0.08,
    size = 5.5
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 100 * max(round_mix$round1_share) + 16) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#D95F02", `FALSE` = "grey65"), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "First-round share by position group",
    subtitle = "Share of each group's draft picks taken in the first round; quarterbacks in orange",
    x = "Draft picks taken in the first round",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "first-round-share-by-position", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: round-mix
round_dist <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_drafted_d) |>
  count(group, round = outcome_draft_round_d, name = "n") |>
  group_by(group) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = levels(round_mix$group_f)),
    round = factor(round, levels = 7:1)
  )
p_dist <- ggplot(round_dist, aes(100 * share, group, fill = round)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, round %s: %d of the group's drafted seasons (%.1f%%)",
        group, round, n, 100 * share
      ),
      data_id = paste(group, round)
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlGnBu", direction = -1, breaks = as.character(1:7)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Every position group's round mix",
    subtitle = "Share of each group's drafted seasons by draft round",
    x = "Share of drafted seasons",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Round",
    caption = "Hover a segment for the count."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_dist)
```
